description: handle_mdn_send builds a Vec<String> sent_creation_ids by pushing creation IDs in the result-processing loop, then immediately uses the vec only for .is_empty() and iteration. Both uses are covered by sent_mdns: the existing HashMap. Idiomatic Rust: use sent_mdns.is_empty() and for creation_id_str in sent_mdns.keys(). The extra Vec allocation and push loop would trigger clippy::needless_collect in some linting configurations. Note: JMAP-o68r.6 tracks this as a P2 efficiency issue; this is the same finding from the Rust idiom angle.
title: sent_creation_ids: Vec<String> should use sent_mdns.keys() directly (iterator idiom)
